messages.content: What is the roster of Manchester United?

function.name: sports_team_get_top_scorer
function.description: Retrieve the top scorer of a sports team in a specific season. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

### How to get the most up‑to‑date roster
- **Official club website**: [www.manutd.com](https://www.manutd.com) – the “Squad” page lists all registered players, including youth and loaned-out players.  
- **Premier League website**: The club’s squad page on the Premier League site shows the official registration list for each season.  
- **Transfermarkt**: Offers a comprehensive list of current squad members, including loan status and contract details.  

If you need the roster for a specific matchday or competition (e.g., Champions League, FA Cup), the club’s match previews or the competition’s official site will list the selected XI.
